units.source_text: 明石姬也觉得此言甚是，心情稍安，然而终于悲伤不堪。

en.t: Lady Akashi also felt that these words were quite right, and her heart was somewhat eased, yet in the end she was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 乳母和一个叫作少将的上级侍女，拿着佩刀和天儿与小女公子同乘。

en.t: The nurse and a senior gentlewoman called Shosho rode together with the little young lady, carrying the protective sword and the infant doll.

units.source_text: 其他几个相貌美好的青年侍女和女童，另乘车子相送。

en.t: Several other lovely young serving women and little girls rode in another carriage to accompany them on the way.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一路上纪念留在邸内的明石姬，痛感自身犯了何等深重的罪恶！

en.t: All along the road, Prince Genji thought of Lady Akashi left behind at the residence, and keenly felt what a grave sin he had committed.
